SELECT
  $__timeGroup(datetime,$__interval) as 'time',
  dbaccounts,
  dbaccounts-warn-banned-suspended-authbanned-invalid as 'usable accounts',
  warn as 'warned',
  suspended,
  banned,
  authbanned,
  invalid
  -- disabled,
  -- inUse as 'in use',
  -- usedIdle as 'idle_used',
  -- unusedIdle as 'idle_unused',
  -- 100*inUse/(inUse+usedIdle+unusedIdle) as '%inuse'
FROM accounts
WHERE
  $__timeFilter(datetime) 
--  rpl = '$RPL' 
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY $__timeGroup(datetime,$__interval)

select
  datetime,
  banned - COALESCE( LAG(banned) OVER (ORDER BY datetime ASC), banned) AS banned,
  authbanned - COALESCE( LAG(authbanned) OVER (ORDER BY datetime ASC), authbanned) AS authbanned


from accounts
where $__timeFilter(datetime) 
order by datetime asc;

with data as (
select reusetime as time,count(reusetime) as accounts
from
(select
(CASE WHEN last_selected is NULL
  THEN now()
  ELSE
    CASE WHEN from_unixtime(last_selected)<now()-interval '$minimum_account_reuse_hours' hour
      THEN
        CASE WHEN consecutive_disable_count<=1
          THEN
            CASE WHEN from_unixtime(ifnull(last_disabled,0))+interval 3 day < now()
              THEN now()
              ELSE from_unixtime(ifnull(last_disabled,0))+interval 3 day
            END
          ELSE
            CASE WHEN from_unixtime(ifnull(last_disabled,0))+interval 30 day < now()
              THEN now()
              ELSE from_unixtime(ifnull(last_disabled,0))+interval 30 day
            END
        END
      ELSE
        CASE WHEN consecutive_disable_count<=1
          THEN greatest(from_unixtime(ifnull(last_disabled,0))+interval 3 day,from_unixtime(last_selected)+interval '$minimum_account_reuse_hours' hour)
          ELSE greatest(from_unixtime(ifnull(last_disabled,0))+interval 30 day,from_unixtime(last_selected)+interval '$minimum_account_reuse_hours' hour)
        END
    END
END
) as reusetime
		
from account
where
suspended=0 and
banned=0 and
auth_banned=0 and
invalid=0 and
warn_expiration < unix_timestamp()
) a
group by reusetime
order by reusetime
)

select
  time,
--  accounts,
  sum(accounts) over (order by time) as accounts
from data;

with data as (
select reusetime as time,count(reusetime) as accounts
from
(select
(CASE WHEN last_selected is NULL
  THEN now()
  ELSE
    CASE WHEN from_unixtime(last_selected)<now()-interval '$minimum_account_reuse_hours' hour
      THEN
        CASE WHEN consecutive_disable_count<=1
          THEN
            CASE WHEN from_unixtime(ifnull(last_disabled,0))+interval 3 day < now()
              THEN now()
              ELSE from_unixtime(ifnull(last_disabled,0))+interval 3 day
            END
          ELSE
            CASE WHEN from_unixtime(ifnull(last_disabled,0))+interval 30 day < now()
              THEN now()
              ELSE from_unixtime(ifnull(last_disabled,0))+interval 30 day
            END
        END
      ELSE
        CASE WHEN consecutive_disable_count<=1
          THEN greatest(from_unixtime(ifnull(last_disabled,0))+interval 3 day,from_unixtime(last_selected)+interval '$minimum_account_reuse_hours' hour)
          ELSE greatest(from_unixtime(ifnull(last_disabled,0))+interval 30 day,from_unixtime(last_selected)+interval '$minimum_account_reuse_hours' hour)
        END
    END
END
) as reusetime
		
from account
where
suspended=0 and
banned=0 and
auth_banned=0 and
invalid=0 and
warn_expiration < unix_timestamp() and
refresh_token<>'' and
from_unixtime(last_refreshed)>now()-interval 28 day
) a
group by reusetime
order by reusetime
)

select
  time,
--  accounts,
  sum(accounts) over (order by time) as accounts_with_valid_token
from data;

SELECT
  ifnull(left(from_unixtime(last_released),13),left(now(),13)) as '_time',
  count(username) as '#accounts released per hour'  
FROM account
GROUP BY left(from_unixtime(last_released),13)
ORDER BY left(from_unixtime(last_released),13)

SELECT
  $__timeGroup(Datetime,$__interval) as 'time',
  consecDis1 as 'Consecutive disabled <= 1',
  consecDis2 as 'Consecutive disabled = 2',
  consecDis3 as 'Consecutive disabled = 3',
  consecDis4p as 'Consecutive disabled >= 4'
FROM accounts
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY $__timeGroup(Datetime,$__interval)

select
now() as time,
100*sum(case when ar_ban_state>=0 then 1 else 0 end) / count(username) as '%tested'
-- sum(case when ar_ban_state=1 then 1 else 0 end) as 'ARban'
from account
where last_selected<unix_timestamp(now()) and banned=0 and auth_banned=0

select
now() as time,
100*sum(case when ar_ban_state<0 then 1 else 0 end) / count(username) as '%inProgress'
-- sum(case when ar_ban_state=1 then 1 else 0 end) as 'ARban'
from account
where last_selected<unix_timestamp(now()) and banned=0 and auth_banned=0

select
now() as time,
-- sum(case when ar_ban_state is NULL then 1 else 0 end) as 'untested',
sum(case when ar_ban_state=0 then 1 else 0 end) as 'noARban',
sum(case when ar_ban_state=1 then 1 else 0 end) as 'ARban'
from account
where last_selected<unix_timestamp(now()) and banned=0 and auth_banned=0

select
-- SUBSTRING_INDEX(ifnull(a.email,'unknown'), '@', -1) as domain,
case when length(ifnull(email,"unknown"))-length(replace(ifnull(email,"unknown"),".",""))>1 then SUBSTRING_INDEX(SUBSTRING_INDEX(ifnull(a.email,'unknown'), '@', -1), '.',-(length(ifnull(email,"unknown"))-length(replace(ifnull(email,"unknown"),".",""))-0)) else SUBSTRING_INDEX(ifnull(a.email,'unknown'), '@', -1) end as domain,
provider,
count(a.username) as accounts,
sum(case when banned=1 then 1 else 0 end) as 'banned',
sum(case when auth_banned>0 then 1 else 0 end) as 'authbanned',
sum(case when refresh_token='' then 1 else 0 end) as noToken,
100*sum(case when refresh_token='' then 1 else 0 end)/count(a.username) as '%NoToken'
from account a
group by domain,provider

select
now() as time,
ar_ban_state*-1 as 'spins',
count(username) as '#accounts'
from account
where ar_ban_state < 0  and banned=0 and auth_banned=0
group by ar_ban_state
order by spins
